The fourth alpha of the **IdeaBlade Validation Editor**, a desktop editor for [IdeaBlade Validation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation)'s validation metadata: fixes to alpha.3, and the first release that alpha.3 can install by itself.

> **Note:** What you see here was written in a few hours with the help of [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). It's meant as a developer tool, not a fully fleshed-out production app.

## Downloads

| | Download | Installing |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.0-alpha.4.exe](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.4/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.0-alpha.4.exe) | Run it. It's not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn: *More info* → *Run anyway*. It installs for everyone (Program Files, with an administrator prompt) or only for you, over an earlier alpha if that's installed. |
| **macOS**, Apple silicon | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.4/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-mac-arm64.dmg) | Open it and drag the app to Applications. It's not signed with an Apple certificate or notarized, so the first time, right-click the app → *Open* → *Open* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/IdeaBlade Validation Editor.app"`). |
| **macOS**, Intel | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.4/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-mac-x64.dmg) | As for Apple silicon. |
| **Linux** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-linux-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.4/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | `chmod +x` it and run it. |
| **Linux**, Debian or Ubuntu (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-linux-amd64.deb](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.4/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-linux-amd64.deb) | `sudo apt install ./IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.4-linux-amd64.deb` |

**Updating:** alpha.3 on Windows or as an AppImage finds this version by itself (at start, every few hours, or Help → Check for Updates…), downloads it, and offers **Restart to update**. On macOS and with the .deb, alpha.3 says it's out and links here. Coming from alpha.1 or alpha.2, install it by hand once.

## What's changed since alpha.3

- **Searching doesn't change the metadata any more.** In the searchable fields that hold a value (`extends`, `from`, a rule's validator, compare's `other`), what you type is only a search until you pick a choice, press Enter or leave the field; before, every keystroke was written into the metadata, so a search like `staff name` showed up as an error while you typed. Esc twice puts the old value back. The Add rows (a new model type, property or rule) work as before.
- **The start page** lines up its recent projects again.
- **The project panel** counts the project's files and sources as they are now, unsaved changes included (right after Add folder, say).
- **The README** has current screenshots, and three new ones: the searchable lists, a validator that doesn't fit its property, and sources from a folder.

See the [README](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.4/README.md) for the details, [alpha.3's notes](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.3) for the bigger changes before this, and the [library's documentation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation/tree/main/docs) for the metadata itself.
